symptom: A long-task rehearsal can claim continuity after mere admission, a short timer, a different native execution, truncated replay or a ready state reached after multiple setup claims.
rule: zstack-verify evidence must bind the real accepted command, boot and funding identity, first-claim setup, remaining auth validity, measured disconnected duration and complete durable replay. Disconnect only the device; retain the first failure and never resubmit an uncertain task.
